name: Kirishima Sakura
source: Kirishima Sakura is an average 14-year-old school girl, who have recently moved to Kanagawa Prefecture with her older sister Kirishima Rena, attended a school there in Gunma Prefecture, her birthplace. Her birthday is October 16th, 2004.
